cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth at a term ≥ 22 weeks
finding: The incidence of postpartum hemorrhage was lower than the rate expected from the literature, and the principal cause for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries was uterine atony.
mod_finding: The incidence of postpartum hemorrhage was lower after cesarean deliveries (2.83%) compared to vaginal deliveries (3.36%).
